title: PardoGarcia2026
description: This dataset contains pre-execution, two-class hand motor imagery EEG (precision pinch vs closed fist) recorded from 10 patients with chronic middle cerebral artery stroke, measured at baseline and after rehabilitation, and from 8 healthy controls. Recordings used 63 BrainVision channels sampled at 1000 Hz during image-cued motor imagery and preparation that preceded cued overt execution. The data support investigation of mu and beta oscillatory changes (event-related desynchronization) associated with rehabilitation after stroke.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainVision (Brain Products) system at 1000 Hz using an Electro-Cap International cap with Ag/AgCl electrodes in a 10-10 montage (59 EEG and 4 EOG channels), referenced to the right mastoid (A2). Participants imagined and prepared the hand grip shown in a visual cue image (pinch or fist) before a later auditory go cue for overt execution. Only the pre-execution interval of 0 to 1.5 s is exposed in this dataset.
